cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Who Cares More?
cards.instruction: Turn every favor, memory, sacrifice, and affectionate gesture into evidence that you care more.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. I'll carry the heavier bag. I care more about your back. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Let me take it for a while.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Then you'd appear to care more about mine.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Only if I take the side with the books.

mechanism: A directs shared carrying and accommodates B wish to help while reserving the heavier work as proof of greater affection.
confusable: Unlike ordinary helpfulness, A ranks who cares more; borrowed authority allows cooperation only in a form preserving A claimed lead.
comparison: Immediate physical burden and concern for backs differ from care measured through saved memories.
seedUse: Use D91-b heavier bag/shared load/books with S02-b changing the participation method to keep the partner engaged.
